timeline.message: change in the code to fix the ui start time which break during live
timeline.author: sid

timeline.body:
- [x] I carefully read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and agree to them.

Fixes #2606 
ui before change while running live video
![Capturebefore](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46790654/64884797-2f588880-d680-11e9-8c03-c5c95b44ab27.PNG)

ui after change in while running live video
![Captureafterlive](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46790654/64884854-51520b00-d680-11e9-9a52-5a08e7fde81e.PNG)

ui after change in normal video 
![Captureafternonlive](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/46790654/64884899-6af35280-d680-11e9-880f-2a580cc079ba.PNG)

@Stypox
The idea behind this is to center the seekbar. After your changes, the seekbar will not be centered. Maybe it is better to detect which of both fields is wider and enlarge the other one.

reply.body:
There is one thing to note: theoretically currentTime width is never bigger than endTime's, so the first 'if' in the code above could be removed.

I think it would be possible to do something using [a table layout](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6647177/set-equal-width-of-columns-in-table-layout-in-android), but I'm not sure.
